reason: The proof establishes each required part of the lemma exactly as stated: 0 ∈ S(k), closure under addition via a full residue-case split using the Kunz inequalities in the s<m and s>m cases, finiteness of the complement by explicit residue-wise bounds, minimal positive element equal to m using positivity of each k_r, and the residue-class minimum equal to r + mk_r by direct membership and lower-bound arguments. The argument aligns with the semantic sketch and supports the inverse construction from a Kunz vector to a numerical semigroup.
